method: TabM 0.0.3 from yandex-research/tabm, with rtdl-num-embeddings 0.0.12. Train a tabular neural classifier on the provided fitting labels from random initialization. Test raw nominal fields and a second representation that appends inferred recurrent-profile and context tokens. No published task results, pretrained embeddings, external rows or language-model calls.
settings: Two estimator trainings, each using one shared-parameter network with eight heads, three blocks of width 128, dropout 0.15, batch 256, 32 epochs, AdamW lr .002 and weight decay .0003. Fixed initialization and order seed 61839. Use MPS when available. Fit category vocabularies only on fitting rows. Nominating a blend adds zero fits.
decision: On the existing development panels compare the frozen equal-tree-and-TabICL reference with each new model at overall shares .125, .25, .5 and 1. Elect on 808 only, keep the reference on a tie and then prefer smaller new weight. Freeze selection and report its performance on the 817 and 807 subsequent panels. Require both nonnegative and pooled gain at least .003 over the prior reference to call it eligible for another fresh study.
